name: LBS
recent: LBS Bina 近期持续进行股份回购，同时集团执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San 在闭市期间多次增持公司股份。公司也推介了位于 Kwasa Damansara、发展总值 RM8.3 billion 的 The Reserva 项目，首阶段预计 2027 年 4 月推出。
notable: 公司推出发展总值 RM8.3 billion 的 The Reserva 项目，位于 Kwasa Damansara，首阶段计划于 2027 年 4 月推出。
集团执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间持续进行股份回购。
risks: 集团执行主席在闭市期间多次进行股份交易，需留意相关持股变动。
公司近期持续进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM340.464 million，环比增长 14.8%，同比增长 9.9%；净利为 RM15.049 million，环比下降 11.6%，同比下降 44.4%，净利率为 4.4%，低于上一季度的 5.7%。

recent_en: LBS Bina has been actively buying back its shares and its Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San has been acquiring shares during the closed period. The company also unveiled The Reserva in Kwasa Damansara with a gross development value of RM8.3 billion, with the first phase targeted for launch in April 2027.
notable_en: The company unveiled The Reserva in Kwasa Damansara with a gross development value of RM8.3 billion, with the first phase planned for launch in April 2027.
Group Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Sri Ir. (Dr.) Lim Hock San acquired shares in the open market multiple times between October and November 2026.
The company conducted ongoing share buybacks between October and November 2026.
risks_en: The Group Executive Chairman conducted multiple share dealings during the closed period; relevant changes in shareholding should be noted.
The company has been conducting ongoing share buybacks, which may affect its share capital structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM340.464 million, up 14.8% QoQ and 9.9% YoY; net income was RM15.049 million, down 11.6% QoQ and 44.4% YoY, with a net margin of 4.4% versus 5.7% in the previous quarter.
